title.ja: PP KRIT - 別れの審査員（Commentator）- Official MV

transcript.text: ตอนที่พยายาม ต้องพยายามเท่าไร

translations.ja: 努力するとき、どれくらい頑張ればいいんだろう
translations.en: How hard did I try when I was trying?
translations.ko: 노력할 때, 얼마나 더 노력해야 할까
translations.zh-TW: 努力的時候 究竟要付出多少努力
translations.id: Saat harus berusaha, seberapa keras harus mencoba?
translations.pt: Quando tento, o quanto preciso tentar?

translations.ja: ルール通りなら、君が目の前にいるんだから、ただ君を引き寄せて抱きしめるだけでいいのに
translations.en: According to the rules, you were ahead, so I just had to embrace you.
translations.ko: 규칙에 따라 그녀가 앞에 있다면, 그냥 그녀를 품에 안으면 돼
translations.zh-TW: 按照規則 你走在前面 只要把你擁入懷中就好
translations.id: Sesuai aturan, kau ada di depan, tinggal meraih dan memelukmu.
translations.pt: Segundo as regras, você estava na frente, era só te abraçar.

transcript.text: คิดว่าฉันชนะ ที่ได้มีเธออยู่เคียงข้างกายใกล้ ๆ

translations.ja: 君をすぐ隣にいさせることができて、僕が勝者なんだって思ってたんだ
translations.en: I thought I won by having you close by my side.
translations.ko: 네가 내 곁에 가까이 있다는 것에 내가 이겼다고 생각했어
translations.zh-TW: 以為我贏了 能有你在身邊緊緊相依
translations.id: Kupikir aku menang karena bisa memilikimu di sisiku.
translations.pt: Achei que tinha vencido por ter você bem perto do meu lado.

transcript.text: แต่ว่าฉันเองคงลืมคิดไป เราเป็นกรรมการ มอบเธอเป็นรางวัลให้คนอื่น

translations.en: But I guess I forgot; I am just the referee, giving you away as a prize to someone else.
translations.ko: 하지만 난 생각하는 걸 잊었나 봐, 우리는 심판일 뿐이고 너를 다른 사람의 상으로 건네준다는 걸
translations.zh-TW: 但我卻忘了 我們是裁判 把你當作獎品頒給了別人
translations.id: Tapi aku mungkin lupa, kita adalah juri, menyerahkanmu sebagai hadiah untuk orang lain.
translations.pt: Mas acho que esqueci de pensar, nós éramos os juízes, entregando você de prêmio para outro.

transcript.text: ล้มแทบทั้งยืน จะฝืนเท่าไร เมื่อสิ้นสุดวาระของใจ

translations.ja: その場に崩れ落ちそうだよ、いくら耐えようとしたって、心の役目が終わってしまったら
translations.en: I almost collapsed, standing, fighting how hard when the heart's term is up.

translations.id: Hampir terjatuh, seberapa keras pun mencoba bertahan, saat masa berlaku hati telah usai.
translations.pt: Quase caio de pé, por mais que eu resista, quando chega ao fim o prazo do coração.
